record.name: The Unmet
record.title: the Unmet
record.role: Satiated Sovereign of Span — the thin one. She took distance entire, and nothing that reaches for her arrives

diminished.note: ⚑ R41, and thin: she reached satiation a generation ago and her hold is incomplete. Arriving means being somewhere — the one thing she refused — and it costs her almost everything.

final.note: ⛔ thin even at the last. The lore's 'beatable in the 30–60 band, if the pipeline is found before it sets.' This is the Sovereign a campaign can finish.

wants: To never again be close enough to be left.
Distance, everywhere — every road a little longer, every letter a little later, every person a little further from the next.
record.fears: ⚠️ Arrival. Being somewhere, next to someone, with nowhere further to go.
record.appearance: Always at the far end of the road. Up close — and almost nobody has been — a young horizon-walker, travel-worn, with eyes that focus past you as if you were already a long way off.
record.voiceHints: She speaks as if calling across a valley: clear, a little too loud, and never waiting for the answer to arrive.
record._authoredWhy: SNG-643, Erik 2026-09-24: 'yes' to a thin seat; 'Span is meant to be distance.' A horizon-walker who could not bear to arrive, and kept going until nothing could reach her. Recent — a generation — and so thin. Her supply line is the Switchback Tollmen: a toll that makes the near far. Her starvation is every crossing kept open to anyone: the Echo Bridge, the Keelmouth slip, the Bridgewright.

arc.name: The Widening
arc.tendency: The world is getting further apart. Roads close or cost more, letters go astray, people who part do not meet again. It has its own causes — tolls, closed borders, the poles pulling — and something new and thin is fed by it.
arc.ifIgnored: Nobody is near anyone. Every place is the far end of a road.
arc.ifEngaged: Crossings kept open to anyone: a bridge with a fair toll, a slipway that turns no one away, a letter carried all the way. Arriving is the whole of the fight.

stages.name: Partings
stages.publicFace: People who part are not meeting again. Nobody decided it; the roads just got longer.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} is where the road gets longer.
stages.onceNamed: The Unmet is being fed by every goodbye.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: tolls raised, passes closed, a family split by a road nobody can afford

effects.why: everyone is counting the miles to the people they love

stages.name: Far Roads
stages.publicFace: Letters come back marked no such place, for places that are still there. Travellers set out and are not heard of.
stages.onceNamed: The distance is hers, and it is growing.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: messengers lost; the near made far

effects.why: nobody knows who is still out there
every road is longer than it was

stages.name: The Unreached
stages.publicFace: Someone is always just ahead on the road, and nobody who follows her comes back.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} guides travellers to someone who is never there.
stages.onceNamed: She has come — thin, diminished, forced to be somewhere — and she is after whoever keeps the crossings open.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: the bridge-keepers, the slip, the Bridgewright

effects.why: the road ahead is never empty and never reached

stages.name: Nowhere Near
stages.publicFace: Every place is the far end of a road. Nobody is near anyone.
stages.onceLineKnown: Every toll you know is hers.
stages.onceNamed: The Unmet holds Span, and nothing arrives.

effects.why: nobody is near enough to trust

marks.mark: a milestone whose count does not go down however far you walk toward the town it names
letters returned stamped no such place, addressed to places that still exist
a map with one road drawn off its edge, in a hand nobody at the map-maker's recognises

artifacts.name: the Farlong Map
artifacts.description: A traveller's map that redraws itself in pale ink. There is one road on it that runs off the edge.
artifacts.whatItDoes: It always shows a shorter way. You are never lost and never caught.
artifacts.whatItCosts: The destination drifts. You never quite arrive, and the people waiting for you begin to forget your face.

feeds.perUse: one deed toward the arc, entered as the user's push — NPC or PC, R40b.4

artifacts.name: the Parting Glass
artifacts.description: A plain travelling cup of horn, rimmed in worn silver. Two people who drink from it part without grief.
artifacts.whatItDoes: Any parting made over it is clean: no grudge, no pursuit, no grief. A feud ends; a hunter lets you go.
artifacts.whatItCosts: You never meet again, whatever either of you does. The distance is kept.
